name: code-default
description: Default rubric for software-engineering tasks — the four canonical dimensions (functional requirements, acceptance criteria, code quality, cyclomatic complexity).

content.summary: Score the submission's code against the task's functional requirements, stated acceptance criteria, implementation quality, and control-flow complexity.

dimensions.name: functional_requirements
dimensions.title: Functional requirements
dimensions.description: Does the artifact implement what the task prompt asked for? Every stated requirement is present and behaves as described.

dimensions.name: acceptance_criteria
dimensions.title: Acceptance criteria
dimensions.description: Do the prompt's stated acceptance checks pass? Each verifiable condition named in the task is met by the submission.

dimensions.name: code_quality
dimensions.title: Code quality
dimensions.description: Is the implementation clean, readable, and idiomatic? Naming, structure, error handling, and absence of dead or copy-pasted code.

dimensions.name: cyclomatic_complexity
dimensions.title: Cyclomatic complexity
dimensions.description: Is the control flow reasonably simple? Score against the measured cyclomatic complexity in ANALYSIS.md — high per-function complexity scores lower.

criteria.text: Example criterion — the generator replaces these with task-specific checkable items.
